meta.description: Unified design system tokens for WeaveDoc — IDE-style local-first academic workbench. All tokens target Avalonia UI ResourceDictionary / XAML styling.

colors.description: Unified color system. A single palette serves both themes via semantic token mapping. Neutral scale inspired by GitHub Primer Dark — proven in high-density IDE contexts.

neutralScale.description: Neutral gray scale covering deepest workspace background to high-contrast text. Tokens are theme-agnostic; semantic Avalonia resource assignment differs per theme.

tokens.name: neutral-950
tokens.role: Deepest background — Dark theme workspace / Markdown editor canvas

tokens.name: neutral-900
tokens.role: Panel / card background in dark theme

tokens.name: neutral-800
tokens.role: Raised surface, hover state, input background in dark theme

tokens.name: neutral-500
tokens.role: Disabled text / placeholder in dark theme

tokens.name: neutral-400
tokens.role: Muted / secondary text in dark theme

tokens.name: neutral-100
tokens.role: Primary text / high-emphasis in dark theme

tokens.name: neutral-50
tokens.role: Highest contrast text in dark theme; Muted background in light theme

tokens.name: neutral-0
tokens.role: Light theme page background / Pure white reading surface

tokens.name: neutral-l20
tokens.role: Light theme raised panel / secondary surface

primaryAccent.description: Scientific Blue — primary interactive accent. Single scale used across both themes via different token assignments.

tokens.name: blue-700
tokens.role: Deep pressed state; focus ring (light theme)

tokens.name: blue-300
tokens.role: Primary interactive (dark theme); Tab underline; Anchor links

tokens.name: blue-100
tokens.role: Surface accent / selected row background (light theme)

tokens.name: blue-50
tokens.role: Light accent background; AI bubble highlight

semantic.description: Semantic status colors for success, warning, error, and info states.

success.label: Success Green — AI idle indicator, export complete, PDF matched

tokens.name: green-400
tokens.role: Success (dark theme); AI idle status dot; Export complete

warning.label: Warning Amber — Memory 70-80%, partial recognition, citation mismatch

error.label: Error Red — Memory >80%, export failure, model load failure, destructive actions

tokens.name: red-400
tokens.role: Error (dark theme); Memory critical; Delete/Restore warning

aiStatus.description: Model status indicator colors (non-semantic — these are fixed LED-style signals).

unloaded.label: Red — model configured but not loaded

idle.label: Green — model ready, waiting for input

inference.label: Green pulse — model generating (with breathing animation)

layout.description: IDE-style single-window multi-panel layout. NOT a web page — no left-nav, no max-width content column.

chrome.note: 7 menus: File, Edit, View, AI, Literature, Export, Help
Left: cursor/word/ref count + sync scroll; Right: AI status + memory

workspace.description: Three-column workspace: PDF Viewer | Markdown Editor | Context Panel

markdownEditor.note: Fills remaining split width; about 65% when context panel is collapsed.

contextPanel.note: Fixed width. Expanded by default at >=1440px; collapsed by default at 1024-1439px. Contains 3 tabs: AI Chat, Literature, Snapshot Timeline.

splitDivider.note: Draggable. Double-click resets to 35:65. Snaps at 25% and 50%.

zIndex.description: Stacking order for overlay elements. In Avalonia, this maps to ZIndex attached property or Panel order.

layers.element: ConfirmDialogHost (global confirmation layer; modal-on-modal when source is already modal)

logo.description: Four-square grid logo using blue primary accent colors. Suitable for window icon and About dialog.

iconSpec.avaloniaImplementation: Avalonia PathIcon with StreamGeometry or SvgImage. Icon data stored as XAML Path markup.
iconSpec.wireframeGlyphNote: Emoji/status glyphs shown in Markdown wireframes are semantic placeholders only; implementation uses PathIcon/StatusDot plus semantic color tokens.

statusDots.description: Micro color-coded dots for model status and connection indicators.

componentMapping.description: How the project's own Avalonia component definitions consume these tokens. Components are defined in UI组件定义.md — this section maps tokens to components.

coreComponents.note: 24px; cursor/word/ref/sync state plus AI/memory; theme-mapped text colors
Streaming AI text with citation chips rendered after completion
Clickable source chips such as [1] p.3
Compact (StatusBar), Detailed (AI Panel), and Row (Settings model list) variants
Compact (StatusBar) and Detailed (Settings) variants; default warning at 70-80%, critical above configured threshold (default 80%)
Global confirmation layer for destructive actions; modal-on-modal only when invoked from an existing modal
ToggleField / NumericField / ComboField / RadioListField standardized 32px form rows
Red deleted / Green added; side-by-side in wide views, inline-compact in 280px panels
